analysis_md:
$$
x'_t\bigg|_{t=\frac{\pi}{4}}=e^t\cos t-e^t\sin t=0,\quad
y'_t\bigg|_{t=\frac{\pi}{4}}=e^t\cos t+e^t\sin t=\sqrt{2}e^{\frac{\pi}{4}},\quad
z'_t\bigg|_{t=\frac{\pi}{4}}=e^t=e^{\frac{\pi}{4}},
$$
则曲线切向量为：$(0,\sqrt{2}e^{\frac{\pi}{4}},e^{\frac{\pi}{4}})$，又由于 $zOx$ 平面的法向量为：$(0,1,0)$，

则
$$
\sin\varphi=\frac{\sqrt{2}e^{\frac{\pi}{4}}}{\sqrt{0+2e^{\frac{\pi}{2}}+e^{\frac{\pi}{2}}}}=\sqrt{\frac{2}{3}}.
$$
